summary: Acceptance-gap closure for merged model-role routing: concurrent hot-reload/reader race test and reviewer-independence assertion (test-only, no production change).

components.owning_subsystem: Existing ModelClientPool role table tests. No production change, no new service, no authority change.
components.disposition: Adds a threaded writer/reader race test (generation monotonicity, no torn candidate reads during concurrent replace_model_roles) and an assertion that execution-role hot reload never touches reviewer resolution. Closes the last acceptance gap from the model-role final review; all other negative paths (429/timeout/network failover, no-candidate, hot-reload atomicity, registry independence, dotenv refresh) were already covered.
evidence: Acceptance review on main=aafae770/25b5820a: 7 of 8 requested negative-path items already covered by merged PR126 tests; the concurrency race item was the sole missing test.
Both new tests pass on base 25b5820a (48+2 directed suite green at delivery).
components.verification_level: Local directed tests green; independent review and remote CI pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Test-only change; no runtime semantics touched. A flaky-machine failure of the race test surfaces a real concurrency defect, never a false success.
components.rollback_route: Revert the test file; no production or durable-state impact.
